text:
Maya: Quick coordination — I'm planning to enable the new hysteresis-based cache_coalesce flag (ff_cache_hysteresis_v2) at 5% canary in prod in ~10m. Can folks confirm rollback guardrails and metrics to watch? :wave:

Kevin: Thanks for the heads-up. +1 on 5% canary. Main things: p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, cache hit ratio, and CPU on inference nodes. If p99 > baseline + 40% OR 5xx spikes > 0.5% we rollback immediately.

Ashley: Adding tail latency on short sequences (<64) as a specific check — we've seen regressions there before. Also confirm we keep KV prefetch disabled for the canary.

Maya: Correct, KV prefetch stays OFF for the canary. The rollout script will only flip batch/coalesce and hysteresis math. Flag payload I'm going to apply:
```json
{
  "ff_cache_hysteresis_v2": {
    "enabled": true,
    "audience": "percent:5",
    "params": {"window_ms": 120, "min_fill": 8, "max_delay_ms": 15}
  }
}
```

Samir: Nice. Who's on-call for infra metric triggers? @Kevin? We should have an automated rollback if the alerts fire within the first 30m.

Kevin: I'm on-call. I'll wire a short-lived alert deck: if p99_token_latency or cache_miss_rate increases over thresholds, run rollback. I can add a PagerDuty action to the deployment job.

Ashley: For perf validation, run the smoke harness against the canary group (use tag canary=cache_hyst_v2) and check these dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/latency/serving and https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/cache/cache-metrics. I'll run the harness and post results.

ops-bot: Canary rollout scheduled by Maya. ff_cache_hysteresis_v2 -> audience: 5% at 2024-09-12T19:10:00Z. Automated rollback: disabled by default (manual confirm required).

Maya: Note: I'm going to enable automated rollback after initial manual watch window of 15m if everyone agrees. We can keep it manual for the first + verify run. Thoughts?

Kevin: Manual for first 15m is fine. I'll stand by for alerts and can flip the rollback switch after that. Also confirm k8s rollout strategy unchanged (we're only touching flag service).

Samir: Small checklist from infra: 1) Canary traffic split validated 2) Metrics ingestion rate OK 3) Heap/GC on cache-worker pods normal 4) No new 429s from frontends.

Ashley: I'll post quick smoke results in ~8m. If we see >2% deviation on these checks we call it.

Maya: Starting enable now (triggering feature-flag update).

deploy-bot: Feature flag ff_cache_hysteresis_v2 set to audience percent:5 by Maya at 1767800015. Change ID: ff-20240912-019.

Ashley: Smoke run finished: p95 +4%, p99 +6% (baseline), cache_hit_ratio +3%, no 5xx. CPU up 2% on cache workers. All within our soft thresholds.

Kevin: No alert fires so far. Waiting through the 15m watch window. I'll prepare the rollback command: `curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/rollback/ff-20240912-019` (requires ops token).

Samir: Agree keep monitoring for 30m for any slow drift. If anyone sees any anomalous tail latencies ping @Kevin and hit :rotating_light:.

Maya: Thanks all — leaving notes here for audit. I'll open a short PR with the flag params and rollout notes after the watch window. :memo:
